landing.title: Job alerts that reach you in time

hero.pill: Built for Kenya’s workers and employers
hero.body: KaziForce matches you with jobs near you and sorts every alert for you, so the urgent ones reach you first, by app, SMS, WhatsApp or email, and the rest wait for your summary.

ticks.sms: Alerts by SMS, even without data

how.title: Three simple steps. No confusing menus.
how.signupBody: Your email, your name and a password. One question per screen, in English or Kiswahili.
how.tellTitle: Tell us what you do or need
how.tellBody: Workers pick their skills and area. Employers post a job in a few taps.
how.alertTitle: Get the right alert at the right time
how.alertBody: Job offers and jobs that close soon come first. Everything else waits in your summary.

levels.title: Every alert is sorted before it reaches you.
levels.body: Our system reads each message and decides how important it is. Scams are blocked, urgent alerts are sent straight away, and small updates are grouped so your phone isn’t buzzing all day.
levels.urgent: Job offers and jobs that close soon. If you miss it, we try your next channel.
levels.medium: Messages and updates on your job applications.
levels.low: New jobs nearby and tips. One email a day, a week or a month: you choose.
levels.spam: Fake job offers and scam messages asking for money are caught and kept away.
levels.urgentTitle: Sent right away, to your first choice
levels.mediumTitle: Sent in the app and by email

employers.title: Fill a shift without the phone calls.

ticks.post: Post a job in under two minutes
ticks.applied: Know straight away when a worker applies
ticks.reach: See how many workers received your job alert

footer.project: A student project at Strathmore University, Nairobi.
footer.privacy: WhatsApp and SMS alerts never include your personal details.
footer.tagline: Real-time work alerts for Kenya’s workforce. Made in Nairobi, powered by a lot of chai.

demo.title: Your alerts
demo.description: Example: new alerts sort themselves into Act now, Check today and When you’re free, and a scam message asking for money is caught and removed.
demo.urgentBody: Mama Njeri Cleaning wants you tomorrow at 8am. Reply within 2 hours.
demo.mediumBody: Can you start at 7 tomorrow morning?
demo.scamTitle: “Pay KES 5,000 to secure your Dubai job”
demo.blocked: 3 spam messages blocked today. You’re welcome.

everyone.title: Easy to use, whether you’re 18 or 80.
everyone.body: Big buttons, clear words, and help in English or Kiswahili. If you can send an SMS, you can use KaziForce.

cta.sub: That’s less time than waiting for a matatu to fill up.
